title: Most people feel overwhelmed by the news because they are reading the wrong things for them.
body:
It is not that there is too much information in the world. It is that the information we consume is rarely curated for our specific interests or needs. When you open a standard news app, you are often fed a firehose of headlines designed to trigger a reaction rather than build understanding.

True information literacy is not about reading everything. It is about reading the right things. Personalization should not mean creating a bubble where you only hear what you agree with. It should mean filtering out the noise so you can focus on the topics that actually impact your work, your life, and your curiosity.

We built Headlinne to change the dynamic. By using AI to learn what you actually care about, we help you cut through the clutter. You get a briefing that respects your time and intelligence, helping you stay informed without the usual digital fatigue.
cta: If you want to reclaim your news feed, you can take a look at how we do it at HEADLINNE.com.
